body.text: Two people converse quietly outdoors, one low male murmur and a softer female reply. Relaxed medieval country road conversation, indistinct syllables with no intelligible words. Warm human vocal tones, not whispering. Clean dry close recording, no wind, insects, buzzing, hiss, music or footsteps. Fade naturally to quiet.
